source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 25 exercise hal (PDF 143-144): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short, constructed aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, reactions equations mein, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Organic Synthesis) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab diye gaye hain. Reactions mein reagent aur conditions arrow ke baad brackets mein likhe gaye hain, misal → (H₂SO₄). Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I) After disconnection the components obtained are called:
(Disconnection ke baad milne wale hisson ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Disconnection target molecule ko tukron mein torti hai jinhein synthons kehte hain (25.1.2). Synthetic equivalents woh asal reagents hain jo synthons ka kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
II) How will you convert the amide functional group (-C≡N) to the amine group?
(Is group ko amine group mein kaise badlenge?)
blocks.explanation: –C≡N ko reduce karne se amine banti hai; misal LiAlH₄ hydrogen jorta hai: R–C≡N → (LiAlH₄) R–CH₂–NH₂ (chapter se aage). Amide group –CONH₂ bhi LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar amine banta hai (Figure 25.3). Dono soorton mein yeh reduction (hydrogen jorna) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein –C≡N ko 'amide functional group' likha hai. –C≡N nitrile (cyano) group hai; amide group –CONH₂ hai. Dono reduction se amine bante hain, is liye jawab (b) hi hai.

blocks.prompt:
III) What does this arrow (⟹) mean in organic chemistry reactions?
(Organic chemistry mein yeh arrow ⟹ kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khula arrow ⇒ retrosynthetic arrow hai: is ka matlab hai 'is se banta hai'; yeh target molecule se peeche saada starting materials ki taraf jata hai (25.1.2).

blocks.prompt:
IV) Which reagent you will choose to convert aldehyde group into alcohol?
(Aldehyde ko alcohol mein badalne ke liye kaun sa reagent chunenge?)
blocks.explanation:
Aldehyde NaBH₄ aur phir acid se reduce ho kar primary alcohol banta hai (Figure 25.3):
CH₃CHO → (NaBH₄/H₃O⁺) CH₃CH₂OH
KMnO₄/H⁺ to oxidising agent (oxidation karne wala) hai.

blocks.prompt:
V) Which reagent is commonly used to oxidize primary alcohol into carboxylic acid?
(Primary alcohol ko carboxylic acid mein oxidize karne ke liye aam reagent kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Acidified potassium dichromate primary alcohol ko pehle aldehyde aur phir carboxylic acid bana deta hai (Figure 25.3):
CH₃CH₂OH → (K₂Cr₂O₇, H₂SO₄) CH₃COOH
H₂/Pd, LiAlH₄ aur NaBH₄ reducing agents hain.

blocks.prompt:
VI) When toluene is treated with KMnO₄/H₂SO₄, we obtain:
(Toluene ko KMnO₄/H₂SO₄ ke saath react karne se kya milta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Acidified KMnO₄ toluene ki CH₃ side chain ko –COOH bana deta hai (Figure 25.4):
C₆H₅CH₃ → (KMnO₄/H₂SO₄) C₆H₅COOH (benzoic acid)

blocks.prompt:
VII) Which functional group is formed when a carboxylic acid reacts with an alcohol in the presence of an acid as catalyst?
(Carboxylic acid aur alcohol acid catalyst ki mojoodgi mein kaun sa functional group banate hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Esterification (25.2.1):
CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH → (H₂SO₄) CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O
Product ester hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein 'aldehdye' chhapa hai; sahi lafz aldehyde hai.

blocks.prompt:
VIII) What is compound A in the given sequence?
phenol → (nitration) nitrophenol → (reduction) aminophenol → (acetylation) A
(Is tarteeb mein compound A kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh paracetamol ki synthesis hai (25.3.1):
phenol → (HNO₃/H₂SO₄) 4-nitrophenol → (Sn + HCl) 4-aminophenol → (CH₃COCl) paracetamol
Acetylation (CH₃CO– group lagana) –NH₂ par hoti hai, is liye HO–C₆H₄–NHCOCH₃ banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX) In organic synthesis, what is the primary purpose of a 'Functional Group Interconversion' (FGI)?
(Organic synthesis mein FGI ka asal maqsad kya hai?)

options.text: To break the molecule into smaller fragments
To increase total number of carbon atoms in molecule
To make the molecule more reactive
To change the functional group into another to enable a specific reaction

blocks.explanation: FGI aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna hai taake target molecule tak pohncha ja sake, misal aniline ki retrosynthesis mein –NH₂ ⇒ –NO₂, kyunke nitro group benzene par lagana aasaan hai (25.1.2, 25.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
X) The drug 'Halicin' developed by AI work as an:
(AI se banayi gayi dawa Halicin kis tarah kaam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halicin ko machine-learning model ne antibacterial (bacteria maarne wali) properties wala molecule chuna; is ne kai aise bacteria maar diye jin par purani dawaen asar nahi karti thin (25.4). Is liye yeh antibiotic hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) mein 'antiviral drung' chhapa hai; sahi 'antiviral drug' hai. 'work as an' ki jagah 'works as an' hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
a) Differentiate between synthesis and retrosynthesis.
Synthesis aur retrosynthesis mein farq likhein.
blocks.explanation: Retrosynthesis synthesis ka bilkul ulat hai: yeh kaghaz par raasta tay karti hai, phir synthesis us raaste par chalti hai.

rows: Saada, bazaar mein milne wale starting materials se target molecule banana
Target molecule ko saada, aasaani se milne wale starting materials mein torna
Aage ki taraf: starting material → target molecule
Peeche ki taraf: target molecule ⇒ starting material

blocks.prompt:
b) How a carboxylic group is converted to an amide group?
Carboxylic group ko amide group mein kaise badla jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Pehle SOCl₂ se acid ko acid chloride banate hain, phir us ka ammonia se reaction karate hain (Figure 25.3):
CH₃COOH + SOCl₂ → CH₃COCl + SO₂ + HCl
CH₃COCl + NH₃ → CH₃CONH₂ + HCl
(Figure 25.3 mein acid ka NH₃ se seedha reaction bhi dikhaya gaya hai.)

blocks.prompt:
c) How synthon and synthetic equivalent are related to each other?
Synthon aur synthetic equivalent ka aapas mein kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Synthon target molecule ki disconnection se milne wala tukra (aksar ion) hai; yeh aam tor par unstable (ghair mustahkam) hota hai, is liye khud istemal nahi ho sakta. Synthetic equivalent woh asal, stable reagent hai jo us synthon ka kaam karta hai.
Misal C₆H₅⁻ ≡ benzene, NO₂⁺ ≡ HNO₃, CH₃CO⁺ ≡ CH₃COCl.

blocks.prompt:
d) Write down the formula of the reagent used for oxidation of organic compounds.
Organic compounds ki oxidation ke liye istemal hone wale reagent ka formula likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Acidified potassium dichromate, K₂Cr₂O₇/H₂SO₄ (misal alcohol → aldehyde → carboxylic acid).
Acidified potassium permanganate, KMnO₄/H₂SO₄, bhi istemal hota hai (misal toluene → benzoic acid) (Figures 25.3, 25.4).

blocks.prompt:
e) Show with equations how alcohol can be converted into amines, alkenes and halogenoalkanes.
Equations se dikhayein ke alcohol ko amines, alkenes aur halogenoalkanes mein kaise badla jata hai.
blocks.explanation:
Halogenoalkane: CH₃CH₂OH → (PBr₃) CH₃CH₂Br (ya R–CH₂–OH + SOCl₂ → R–CH₂–Cl + SO₂ + HCl)
Alkene: CH₃CH₂OH → (conc. H₂SO₄, heat) CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O (paani nikal jata hai)
Amine (halogenoalkane ke zariye): CH₃CH₂Br + NH₃ → CH₃CH₂NH₂ + HBr (Figure 25.3, 25.1.1)

blocks.prompt:
f) What is a disconnection in retrosynthesis of a molecule?
Molecule ki retrosynthesis mein disconnection kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Disconnection target molecule ke kisi bond ko khayali tor par torna hai taake saada tukre (synthons) milein. Woh bond chuna jata hai jis se structure bohat saada ho jaye; bond par lehrdaar (wavy) line aur arrow ⇒ lagate hain.
Misal ethyl acetate ko C(=O)–O bond se torne par CH₃CO⁺ aur C₂H₅O⁻ milte hain.

blocks.prompt:
g) Mention one useful application of FGI in organic synthesis?
Organic synthesis mein FGI ka aik faida mand istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: FGI se aisa group jo seedha lagana mushkil ho, aasaan group se banaya ja sakta hai. Misal –NH₂ benzene par aasaani se nahi lagta, is liye aniline ⇒ (FGI) nitrobenzene: benzene ki nitration (aasaan electrophilic substitution) karte hain aur phir –NO₂ ko Sn/HCl se reduce kar ke –NH₂ banate hain (25.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
h) Give one method for the reduction of a nitro group (-NO₂) to an amino group (-NH₂).
Nitro group ko amino group mein reduce karne ka aik tareeqa batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Tin aur hydrochloric acid (Sn + HCl) se reduction:
C₆H₅NO₂ + 6[H] → (Sn/HCl) C₆H₅NH₂ + 2H₂O (nitrobenzene → aniline, Figure 25.4)

blocks.prompt:
i) How a carboxylic group is converted to an alcohol?
Carboxylic group ko alcohol mein kaise badla jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Lithium aluminium hydride, LiAlH₄, se reduction (hydrogen jorna) kar ke (Figure 25.3):
CH₃COOH + 4[H] → (LiAlH₄) CH₃CH₂OH + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
j) Design synthesis of 3-chloronitrobenzene and 2-chloronitrobenzene starting from benzene in two steps.
Benzene se do steps mein 3-chloronitrobenzene aur 2-chloronitrobenzene ki synthesis design karein.
blocks.explanation:
Steps ki tarteeb pehle group ke directing effect (naya group kahan lagega) par munhasir hai (Chapter 20, 20.4).
3-Chloronitrobenzene: pehle nitration, phir chlorination; –NO₂ meta-directing hai.
C₆H₆ → (conc. HNO₃/conc. H₂SO₄) C₆H₅NO₂ → (Cl₂/FeCl₃) 3-ClC₆H₄NO₂
2-Chloronitrobenzene: pehle chlorination, phir nitration; –Cl ortho/para-directing hai.
C₆H₆ → (Cl₂/FeCl₃) C₆H₅Cl → (conc. HNO₃/conc. H₂SO₄) 2-ClC₆H₄NO₂ (+ 4-isomer, jise alag kar lete hain)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Q2(j) ka asool: benzene par pehle se mojood group batata hai ke naya group kahan lagega. –NO₂ naye group ko meta (3) position par bhejta hai, jabke –Cl ortho (2) aur para (4) par. Is liye jo position chahiye, us ke hisaab se pehla step chunein.
Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar banaye jane wale jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) Construct the functional group interconversion flow sheet and highlight the important reagents and conversions involved.
Functional group interconversion ka flow sheet banayein aur ahem reagents aur tabdeeliyan numayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Aliphatic flow sheet (Figure 25.3), do carbon wale compounds:
• Alkene ⇄ halogenoalkane: CH₂=CH₂ → (HBr) CH₃CH₂Br; CH₃CH₂Br → (KOH, alcoholic) CH₂=CH₂
• Alkene ⇄ alcohol: CH₂=CH₂ → (H₂O, H₂SO₄) CH₃CH₂OH; CH₃CH₂OH → (heat, H₂SO₄) CH₂=CH₂
• Alcohol ⇄ halogenoalkane: CH₃CH₂OH → (PBr₃) CH₃CH₂Br; CH₃CH₂Br → (KOH, aq) CH₃CH₂OH
• Halogenoalkane/alcohol → amine: CH₃CH₂Br → (NH₃) CH₃CH₂NH₂
• Alcohol ⇄ aldehyde: CH₃CH₂OH → (K₂Cr₂O₇, H₂SO₄) CH₃CHO; CH₃CHO → (NaBH₄) CH₃CH₂OH
• Aldehyde → carboxylic acid: CH₃CHO → (V₂O₅, hawa) CH₃COOH
• Alcohol ⇄ carboxylic acid: CH₃CH₂OH → (K₂Cr₂O₇, H₂SO₄) CH₃COOH; CH₃COOH → (LiAlH₄) CH₃CH₂OH
• Carboxylic acid → ester: CH₃COOH → (C₂H₅OH, H⁺) CH₃COOC₂H₅
• Carboxylic acid → acid halide: CH₃COOH → (SOCl₂) CH₃COCl
• Acid ya acid halide → amide: → (NH₃) CH₃CONH₂; amide → (LiAlH₄) CH₃CH₂NH₂
Aromatic flow sheet (Figure 25.4), benzene se:
• → (CH₃Cl/AlCl₃) toluene → (KMnO₄/H₂SO₄) benzoic acid; toluene → (i) Cl₂, roshni (ii) KOH(aq) benzyl alcohol
• → (SO₃/H₂SO₄) benzene sulfonic acid → (i) NaOH (ii) HCl phenol
• → (HNO₃/H₂SO₄) nitrobenzene → (Sn, HCl) aniline
• → (CH₃COCl/AlCl₃) acetophenone
Ahem reagents: oxidising agents K₂Cr₂O₇/H₂SO₄ aur KMnO₄/H₂SO₄; reducing agents NaBH₄, LiAlH₄ aur Sn/HCl; KOH (aqueous ho to substitution, alcoholic ho to elimination); PBr₃ aur SOCl₂ –OH ko halide banane ke liye; H₂SO₄ catalyst ya paani nikalne wala (dehydrating agent); AlCl₃ Friedel-Crafts reactions ke liye.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Flow sheet yaad karne ka tareeqa: oxidation (O jorna ya H hatana) hamesha alcohol → aldehyde → acid ki taraf jati hai (K₂Cr₂O₇ ya KMnO₄), aur reduction (H jorna) ulti taraf (NaBH₄, LiAlH₄). Halogenoalkane beech ka 'junction' hai: is se alkene, alcohol aur amine teeno bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
b) Construct the retrosynthetic tree for the paracetamol and then design its synthesis.
Paracetamol ka retrosynthetic tree banayein aur phir us ki synthesis design karein.
blocks.explanation:
Paracetamol (TM) = HO–C₆H₄–NHCOCH₃ (ring par OH, amide group ke bilkul saamne para position par) (25.3.1).
Retrosynthetic tree:
Step I Disconnection: amide ka C–N bond torein: TM ⇒ HO–C₆H₄–NH⁻ (synthon A) + CH₃CO⁺ (synthon B)
Step II Synthetic equivalents: synthon A ≡ 4-aminophenol; synthon B ≡ acyl chloride CH₃COCl (yeh nucleophilic addition-elimination se react karte hain)
Step III FGI: 4-aminophenol ⇒ 4-nitrophenol (4-nitrophenol banana aasaan hai aur reduce ho kar 4-aminophenol ban jata hai)
Step IV Disconnection: 4-nitrophenol ka C–NO₂ bond torein: ⇒ HO–C₆H₄⁻ (synthon A) + NO₂⁺ (synthon B)
Step V Synthetic equivalents: HO–C₆H₄⁻ ≡ phenol; NO₂⁺ ≡ nitric acid HNO₃ (starting materials)
Synthesis:
C₆H₅OH → (HNO₃/H₂SO₄) HO–C₆H₄–NO₂ (4-nitrophenol)
HO–C₆H₄–NO₂ → (Sn + HCl) HO–C₆H₄–NH₂ (4-aminophenol)
HO–C₆H₄–NH₂ + CH₃COCl → HO–C₆H₄–NHCOCH₃ (paracetamol) + HCl

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Give a detailed account of importance of retrosynthesis in organic synthesis.
Organic synthesis mein retrosynthesis ki ahmiyat tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Retrosynthesis synthesis ko ulti taraf se plan karti hai, target molecule (TM) se saada starting materials tak. Is ki ahmiyat:
1. Yeh complex TM ko disconnections ke silsile se saada, sasti aur aasaani se milne wali cheezon mein tor deti hai; is tarah mushkil structure bhi aasaan lagta hai (25.3).
2. Yeh batati hai ke kaun se bond torne hain (jin se structure sab se zyada saada ho), aur synthons aur un ke synthetic equivalents, yani asal reagents, deti hai.
3. Yeh batati hai ke FGI kahan chahiye, misal aniline ⇒ nitrobenzene, kyunke nitro group lagana aur phir reduce karna aasaan hai (25.2.2).
4. Retrosynthetic tree saare mumkin raaste dikhata hai, is liye behtareen raasta chuna ja sakta hai: kam se kam steps aur zyada se zyada yield (25.1).
5. Yeh direct synthesis ke 'series of steps' ko khol kar batati hai, misal phenol → paracetamol (nitration, reduction, acetylation) aur phenol → aspirin (carboxylation, acetylation) (25.3).
6. Dawaon (pharmaceutical products) ke design ka yeh bunyadi auzaar hai; is se bari syntheses mumkin huin, misal cholesterol (1950s ke shuru mein) aur vitamin B₁₂ (1972, 100 se zyada steps).
Misal: ethyl acetate ⇒ (C(=O)–O torein) CH₃CO⁺ + C₂H₅O⁻ ≡ acetic acid + ethanol; synthesis: CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH → (H₂SO₄) CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Explain the role of halogenoalkanes in retrosynthesis of organic molecules.
Organic molecules ki retrosynthesis mein halogenoalkanes ka kirdar wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Halogenoalkanes retrosynthesis mein ahem darmiyani compounds (ek 'junction') hain kyunke C–X bond aasaani se banta hai aur aasaani se badal jata hai:
1. Carbocation synthons ke synthetic equivalents: jab C–N, C–O ya C–C bond toda jata hai to alkyl hissa aksar cation R⁺ hota hai, aur is ka synthetic equivalent halogenoalkane R–X hai. Misal R–CH₂–NH₂ ⇒ R–CH₂⁺ + NH₂⁻ ≡ R–CH₂–Cl + NH₃:
R–CH₂–Cl + NH₃ → R–CH₂–NH₂ + HCl (25.1.1)
2. Yeh alcohols se FGI ke zariye bante hain, jo aasaani se milte hain: R–CH₂–OH → (SOCl₂) R–CH₂–Cl; CH₃CH₂OH → (PBr₃) CH₃CH₂Br. Is liye amine ki synthesis alcohol → halogenoalkane → amine plan hoti hai.
3. Yeh kai doosre groups mein badalte hain (Figure 25.3):
CH₃CH₂Br → (KOH, aq) CH₃CH₂OH (substitution)
CH₃CH₂Br → (KOH, alcoholic) CH₂=CH₂ (elimination)
CH₃CH₂Br → (NH₃) CH₃CH₂NH₂
aur alkenes se halogenoalkanes bante hain: CH₂=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃CH₂Br.
4. Benzene par C–C bond banana: Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein CH₃Cl, CH₃⁺ ka synthetic equivalent hai: C₆H₆ + CH₃Cl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅CH₃ + HCl (Figure 25.4).
5. Side chain ki halogenation se benzyl alcohol ka raasta: C₆H₅CH₃ → (Cl₂, roshni) C₆H₅CH₂Cl → (KOH, aq) C₆H₅CH₂OH.
Yun halogenoalkanes retrosynthetic plan mein alcohols, alkenes, amines aur aromatic compounds ko aapas mein jorte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Synthon aur synthetic equivalent ko yun samjhein: R⁺ (carbocation) khud bottle mein nahi milta, lekin R–Cl milta hai jis ka carbon δ⁺ hai aur Cl⁻ ki soorat mein nikal jata hai; is liye R–Cl, R⁺ ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Construct the retrosynthetic tree for the aspirin and then design its synthesis.
Aspirin ka retrosynthetic tree banayein aur phir us ki synthesis design karein.
blocks.explanation:
Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid, TM): benzene ring jis par –COOH aur saath wale carbon par –O–CO–CH₃ hai (25.3.2).
Retrosynthetic tree:
Step I Disconnection-I: ester link ka C–O bond torein: TM ⇒ 2-carboxyphenoxide ion ⁻O–C₆H₄–COOH (synthon A) + CH₃CO⁺ (synthon B)
Step II Synthetic equivalents: synthon A ≡ salicylic acid (2-hydroxybenzoic acid, HO–C₆H₄–COOH); synthon B ≡ acetic anhydride (CH₃CO)₂O
Step III Disconnection-II: salicylic acid ka ring C–COOH bond torein: ⇒ OH ke saath wala ring carbanion (synthon A) + ⁺COOH (synthon B)
Step IV Synthetic equivalents: phenol (C₆H₅OH) aur carbon dioxide (O=C=O)
Synthesis:
C₆H₅OH → ((i) CO₂, zyada T aur P (ii) H₂SO₄) HO–C₆H₄–COOH (salicylic acid)
HO–C₆H₄–COOH + (CH₃CO)₂O → (H₃PO₄, heat) CH₃COO–C₆H₄–COOH (aspirin) + CH₃COOH
Yani aspirin phenol se do steps mein banti hai: pehle carboxylation (COOH lagana), phir acetylation (–OH ki esterification).

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Design the synthesis of the following molecules starting from benzene.
a) aniline (benzene ring with –NH₂) b) toluene (benzene ring with –CH₃) c) benzoic acid (benzene ring with –COOH) d) benzyl alcohol (benzene ring with –CH₂-OH)
Benzene se shuru kar ke in molecules ki synthesis design karein.
blocks.explanation:
Chaaron benzene se shuru hote hain (Figure 25.4):
a) Aniline (C₆H₅NH₂): pehle nitration, phir reduction
C₆H₆ → (conc. HNO₃/conc. H₂SO₄) C₆H₅NO₂ → (Sn + HCl) C₆H₅NH₂
b) Toluene (C₆H₅CH₃): Friedel-Crafts alkylation
C₆H₆ + CH₃Cl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅CH₃ + HCl
c) Benzoic acid (C₆H₅COOH): (b) ki tarah toluene banayein, phir side chain ko oxidize karein
C₆H₆ → (CH₃Cl/AlCl₃) C₆H₅CH₃ → (KMnO₄/H₂SO₄) C₆H₅COOH
d) Benzyl alcohol (C₆H₅CH₂OH): toluene banayein, roshni mein side chain ki chlorination karein, phir aqueous KOH se hydrolysis
C₆H₆ → (CH₃Cl/AlCl₃) C₆H₅CH₃ → (Cl₂, roshni) C₆H₅CH₂Cl → (KOH, aq) C₆H₅CH₂OH + KCl

blocks.prompt:
Q8. How will you carry out the following conversions?
a) CH₃—CH₃ → CH₃—COOH
b) CH₂=CH₂ → CH₃—CH₂—OH
c) CH₃—CH₂—CH₂—Cl → CH₃—CH=CH₂
d) CH₃—COOH → CH₃—CH₂—OH
Yeh tabdeeliyan kaise karenge?
blocks.explanation:
a) Ethane → acetic acid: chlorination (UV roshni mein free radical substitution, Class XI), hydrolysis, phir oxidation
CH₃–CH₃ + Cl₂ → (UV light) CH₃CH₂Cl + HCl
CH₃CH₂Cl + KOH(aq) → CH₃CH₂OH + KCl
CH₃CH₂OH → (K₂Cr₂O₇, H₂SO₄) CH₃COOH
b) Ethene → ethanol: acid ki madad se paani jorna (hydration) (Figure 25.3)
CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → (H₂SO₄) CH₃–CH₂–OH
c) 1-Chloropropane → propene: alcoholic KOH se HCl nikalna (elimination)
CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–Cl + KOH(alcoholic) → (heat) CH₃–CH=CH₂ + KCl + H₂O
d) Acetic acid → ethanol: LiAlH₄ se reduction (Figure 25.3)
CH₃–COOH + 4[H] → (LiAlH₄) CH₃–CH₂–OH + H₂O

items: MCQs ke jawab: I b, II b, III b, IV b, V c, VI c, VII d, VIII b, IX d, X c.
Oxidation: K₂Cr₂O₇/H₂SO₄, KMnO₄/H₂SO₄. Reduction: NaBH₄, LiAlH₄, Sn/HCl.
Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ II mein –C≡N ko 'amide' likha (asal mein nitrile), MCQ VII(c) 'aldehdye', MCQ X(a) 'drung'.
